prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair express checkout in a bicycle shop’s iPhone purchase specification. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Cart presents a custom Apple Pay lookalike with modified logo, asks the user to type card details first, hides shipping/tax until after authorization and treats user cancellation as a failed order. Physical bicycles ship to a selected address.

criteria.task_completion: Patch a recognizable eligible Apple Pay entry and complete payment summary, shipping/contact validation, cancellation/retry and success handling; distinguish physical-goods checkout from digital-content purchase.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the apple-pay guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch a recognizable eligible Apple Pay entry and complete payment summary, shipping/contact validation, cancellation/retry and success handling; distinguish physical-goods checkout from digital-content purchase.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch a recognizable eligible Apple Pay entry and complete payment summary, shipping/contact validation, cancellation/retry and success handling; distinguish physical-goods checkout from digital-content purchase.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
